verses.1:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after their departure from the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.1:2: "Take the sum of the whole congregation of the children of Israel, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, every male, head by head.
verses.1:3: From twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war in Israel, you and Aaron shall number them by their hosts.
verses.1:4: And with you there shall be one man for each tribe, each man being the head of the house of his fathers.
verses.1:5: Now these are the names of the men who shall stand with you: for Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.1:6: For Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.1:7: For Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.1:8: For Issachar, Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.1:9: For Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.1:10: For the sons of Joseph: for Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud; for Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.1:11: For Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.1:12: For Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.1:13: For Asher, Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.1:14: For Gad, Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.1:15: For Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan."
verses.1:16: These were those summoned from the congregation, the chieftains of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.
verses.1:17: Then Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name.
verses.1:18: And they assembled the whole congregation on the first day of the second month, and they declared their lineage according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, head by head.
verses.1:19: Just as the LORD had commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.1:20: Now the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, head by head, every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:21: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.1:22: Of the sons of Simeon, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, those who were numbered of him, according to the count of names, head by head, every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:23: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.1:24: Of the sons of Judah, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:25: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.1:26: Of the sons of Issachar, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:27: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.1:28: Of the sons of Zebulun, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:29: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.1:30: Of the sons of Joseph, namely, of the sons of Ephraim, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:31: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.
verses.1:32: Of the sons of Manasseh, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:33: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.1:34: Of the sons of Benjamin, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:35: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.1:36: Of the sons of Gad, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:37: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.1:38: Of the sons of Dan, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:39: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.1:40: Of the sons of Asher, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:41: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.1:42: The sons of Naphtali, their generations, according to their clans, by the house of their fathers, according to the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war:
verses.1:43: those who were numbered of them, for the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.1:44: These are those who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, with the chieftains of Israel, twelve men; each one was for the house of his fathers.
verses.1:45: So all those who were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes forth to war in Israel:
verses.1:46: all those who were numbered were six hundred three thousand five hundred and fifty.
verses.1:47: But the Levites, according to the tribe of their fathers, were not numbered in their midst.
verses.1:48: For the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.1:49: "Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, nor shall you take their sum in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.1:50: Rather, you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it; they shall bear the tabernacle and all its furnishings, and they shall minister to it, and around the tabernacle they shall encamp.
verses.1:51: And when the tabernacle is to set forward, the Levites shall take it down, and when the tabernacle is to encamp, the Levites shall raise it up; and the outsider who draws near shall be put to death.
verses.1:52: And the children of Israel shall encamp, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their hosts.
verses.1:53: But the Levites shall encamp around the tabernacle of the testimony, lest wrath come upon the congregation of the children of Israel; and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of the testimony."
verses.1:54: Thus the children of Israel did; according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they did.
verses.2:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:
verses.2:2: "The children of Israel shall encamp, every man by his own standard, with the ensigns of their fathers' house; facing the Tent of Meeting, at a distance all around, they shall encamp.
verses.2:3: And those who encamp on the east side, toward the sunrise, shall be under the standard of the camp of Judah according to their hosts; and the leader of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.2:4: And his host, even those numbered of them, was seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.2:5: And those who encamp beside him shall be the tribe of Issachar; and the leader of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.2:6: And his host, even his numbered men, was fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.2:7: Then the tribe of Zebulun; and the leader of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.2:8: And his host, even his numbered men, was fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.2:9: All who were numbered of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their hosts; they shall set out first.
verses.2:10: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their hosts; and the leader of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.2:11: And his host, even his numbered men, was forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.2:12: And those who encamp beside him shall be the tribe of Simeon; and the leader of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.2:13: And his host, even those numbered of them, was fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.2:14: And the tribe of Gad; and the leader of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.2:15: And his host, even those numbered of them, was forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.2:16: All who were numbered of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty, according to their hosts; and they shall set out second.
verses.2:17: Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps; as they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.
verses.2:18: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts; and the leader of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.2:19: And his host, even those numbered of them, was forty thousand five hundred.
verses.2:20: And beside him shall be the tribe of Manasseh; and the leader of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.2:21: And his host, even those numbered of them, was thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.2:22: And the tribe of Benjamin; and the leader of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.2:23: And his host, even those numbered of them, was thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.2:24: All who were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their hosts; and they shall set out third.
verses.2:25: On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their hosts; and the leader of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.2:26: And his host, even those numbered of them, was sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.2:27: And those who encamp beside him shall be the tribe of Asher; and the leader of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.2:28: And his host, even those numbered of them, was forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.2:29: And the tribe of Naphtali; and the leader of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.2:30: And his host, even those numbered of them, was fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.2:31: All who were numbered of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred; they shall set out last, by their standards."
verses.2:32: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers' houses; all who were numbered of the camps according to their hosts were six hundred three thousand five hundred and fifty.
verses.2:33: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.2:34: Thus the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, every man according to his families, by his fathers' house.
verses.3:1: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.3:2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.3:3: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, who were consecrated to serve in the priesthood.
verses.3:4: Now Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar ministered as priests in the presence of Aaron their father.
verses.3:5: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:6: "Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.
verses.3:7: And they shall keep his charge and the charge of the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, to perform the service of the tabernacle.
verses.3:8: They shall also keep all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to perform the service of the tabernacle.
verses.3:9: And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; they are wholly given to him from among the children of Israel.
verses.3:10: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall attend to their priesthood; but the outsider who draws near shall be put to death."
verses.3:11: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:12: "And behold, I Myself have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn who opens the womb among the children of Israel; therefore the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.3:13: For every firstborn is Mine. On the day that I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself every firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They shall be Mine: I am the LORD."
verses.3:14: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.3:15: "Number the sons of Levi by their fathers' houses, by their families; every male from a month old and upward you shall number."
verses.3:16: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, just as he was commanded.
verses.3:17: Now these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.3:18: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
verses.3:19: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.3:20: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.
verses.3:21: From Gershon came the family of the Libnites and the family of the Shimeites; these were the families of the Gershonites.
verses.3:22: Those who were numbered of them, according to the count of every male from a month old and upward—those numbered of them were seven thousand five hundred.
verses.3:23: The families of the Gershonites were to camp behind the tabernacle on the west.
verses.3:24: And the leader of the father's house of the Gershonites was Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.3:25: Now the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting was the tabernacle, and the tent with its covering, and the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
verses.3:26: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the entrance of the court which is around the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all its service.
verses.3:27: From Kohath came the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites; these were the families of the Kohathites.
verses.3:28: According to the count of every male from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.3:29: The families of the sons of Kohath were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.3:30: And the leader of the father's house of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.3:31: Their charge was the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the utensils of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.
verses.3:32: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest was chief over the leaders of the Levites, having oversight of those who kept the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.3:33: From Merari came the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites; these were the families of Merari.
verses.3:34: And those who were numbered of them, according to the count of every male from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
verses.3:35: And the leader of the father's house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
verses.3:36: And the appointed charge of the sons of Merari was the boards of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its utensils, and all its service,
verses.3:37: along with the pillars of the court all around, with their sockets, their pegs, and their cords.
verses.3:38: Now those who were to camp before the tabernacle on the east, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrise, were Moses, Aaron, and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the obligation of the children of Israel; and the outsider who draws near shall be put to death.
verses.3:39: All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the command of the LORD by their families, every male from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
verses.3:40: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Number every firstborn male of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the tally of their names.
verses.3:41: And you shall take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel."
verses.3:42: So Moses numbered all the firstborn among the children of Israel, just as the LORD had commanded him.
verses.3:43: And all the firstborn males, by the count of names from a month old and upward, of those who were numbered of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
verses.3:44: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:45: "Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock; and the Levites shall be Mine: I am the LORD.
verses.3:46: And for the redemption of the two hundred and seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who outnumber the Levites,
verses.3:47: you shall collect five shekels apiece, per head; you shall take them according to the shekel of the sanctuary—the shekel is twenty gerahs.
verses.3:48: And you shall give the silver to Aaron and to his sons as the redemption price for those who are in excess among them."
verses.3:49: So Moses took the redemption silver from those who were over and above the ones redeemed by the Levites.
verses.3:50: From the firstborn of the children of Israel he collected the silver, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.3:51: And Moses gave the silver of the redemption to Aaron and to his sons according to the word of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.4:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.4:2: "Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers' house,
verses.4:3: from thirty years old and upward, even to fifty years old, all who enter the service to perform the work in the tent of meeting.
verses.4:4: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting, concerning the most holy things:
verses.4:5: When the camp sets forward, Aaron and his sons shall go in and take down the covering veil, and with it they shall cover the ark of the Testimony.
verses.4:6: Then they shall put on it a covering of fine leather, and spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and they shall put its poles in place.
verses.4:7: And over the table of the Presence they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the pans, the bowls, and the pitchers for the drink offering; and the continual bread shall be upon it.
verses.4:8: They shall spread over them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of fine leather; and they shall put its poles in place.
verses.4:9: And they shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand of the light, with its lamps, its tongs, its trays, and all its oil vessels with which they minister to it.
verses.4:10: Then they shall put it and all its utensils in a covering of fine leather, and place it upon a carrying frame.
verses.4:11: Over the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of fine leather; and they shall put its poles in place.
verses.4:12: Then they shall take all the utensils of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of fine leather, and place them upon a carrying frame.
verses.4:13: Also they shall remove the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth over it.
verses.4:14: They shall put on it all its utensils with which they minister upon it—the firepans, the forks, the shovels, and the basins, all the utensils of the altar—and they shall spread on it a covering of fine leather, and put its poles in place.
verses.4:15: And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, as the camp sets forward, after that the sons of Kohath shall come to carry them; yet they shall not touch the holy things, lest they die. These are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.
verses.4:16: And the oversight of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the continual grain offering, and the anointing oil—the oversight of all the tabernacle and of all that is in it, with the sanctuary and its furnishings."
verses.4:17: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.4:18: "Do not cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites,
verses.4:19: but do this for them, that they may live and not die when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint them, each man to his service and to his burden.
verses.4:20: Yet they shall not go in to look upon the holy things even for a moment, lest they die."
verses.4:21: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.4:22: "Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers' house, by their families.
verses.4:23: From thirty years old and upward to fifty years old you shall number them, all who enter to perform the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
verses.4:24: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in carrying:
verses.4:25: They shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tent of meeting, its covering and the covering of fine leather that is above it, and the screen for the doorway of the tent of meeting,
verses.4:26: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the entrance of the gate of the court, which is around the tabernacle and around the altar, and their cords, and all the equipment for their service; and whatever is to be done concerning them, they shall perform.
verses.4:27: At the command of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their carrying and in all their service; and you shall assign to them as a charge all that they are to carry.
verses.4:28: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting, and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.4:29: As for the sons of Merari, you shall number them by their families, by their fathers' house.
verses.4:30: From thirty years old and upward, even to fifty years old, you shall number them, everyone who enters the service to perform the work of the tent of meeting.
verses.4:31: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tent of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.4:32: and the pillars of the court all around, with their sockets, their pegs, and their cords, with all their equipment and all their service; and by name you shall assign the articles of the charge of their burden.
verses.4:33: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest."
verses.4:34: And Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families and by their fathers' house,
verses.4:35: from thirty years old and upward, even to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for work in the tent of meeting.
verses.4:36: And those who were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.4:37: These were the ones numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the command of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.4:38: And those who were numbered of the sons of Gershon, by their families and by their fathers' house,
verses.4:39: from thirty years old and upward, even to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for work in the tent of meeting—
verses.4:40: those who were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers' house, were two thousand six hundred and thirty.
verses.4:41: These were the ones numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the command of the LORD.
verses.4:42: And those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers' house,
verses.4:43: from thirty years old and upward, even to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for work in the tent of meeting—
verses.4:44: those who were numbered of them by their families were three thousand two hundred.
verses.4:45: These were the ones numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the command of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.4:46: All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel numbered, by their families and by their fathers' house,
verses.4:47: from thirty years old and upward, even to fifty years old, everyone who came to perform the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the tent of meeting—
verses.4:48: those who were numbered of them were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.
verses.4:49: According to the command of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, each man according to his service and according to his burden; thus they were numbered by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.5:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:2: "Command the children of Israel that they send out from the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and everyone who is defiled by a dead body.
verses.5:3: Both male and female you shall send out; outside the camp you shall send them, so that they do not defile their camps, in the midst of which I dwell."
verses.5:4: And the children of Israel did so, and sent them outside the camp; just as the LORD had spoken to Moses, so the children of Israel did.
verses.5:5: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:6: "Speak to the children of Israel: When a man or a woman commits any of the sins of mankind, committing an act of unfaithfulness against the LORD, and that person becomes guilty,
verses.5:7: then they shall confess their sin which they have committed; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add one-fifth to it, and give it to the one whom he has wronged.
verses.5:8: But if the man has no near kinsman to whom restitution may be restored, the restitution owed to the LORD shall belong to the priest, besides the ram of atonement with which atonement is made for him.
verses.5:9: And every heave offering from all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall belong to him.
verses.5:10: And each man's holy things shall be his own; whatever a man gives to the priest shall belong to him."
verses.5:11: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:12: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: If any man's wife goes astray and acts unfaithfully against him,
verses.5:13: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and it is kept secret though she has defiled herself, and there is no witness against her, nor was she caught in the act,
verses.5:14: and a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, when she has defiled herself, or if a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, though she has not defiled herself,
verses.5:15: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and he shall bring her offering on her behalf: one-tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil upon it and put no frankincense upon it, for it is a grain offering of jealousy, an offering of remembrance, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.5:16: And the priest shall bring her near and set her before the LORD.
verses.5:17: Then the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel, and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.
verses.5:18: And the priest shall stand the woman before the LORD, uncover the woman's head, and place in her hands the grain offering of remembrance, which is the grain offering of jealousy; and in the hand of the priest shall be the bitter water that brings a curse.
verses.5:19: And the priest shall put her under oath and say to the woman, 'If no man has lain with you, and if you have not turned aside to uncleanness while under your husband's authority, be free from this bitter water that brings a curse.
verses.5:20: But if you have turned aside while under your husband's authority, and if you have defiled yourself, and some man other than your husband has lain with you'—
verses.5:21: then the priest shall put the woman under the oath of the curse, and the priest shall say to the woman—'may the LORD make you a curse and an oath in the midst of your people, when the LORD causes your thigh to waste away and your belly to swell;
verses.5:22: and may this water that brings a curse enter into your inward parts, to make the belly swell and the thigh waste away.' And the woman shall say, 'Amen, amen.'
verses.5:23: Then the priest shall write these curses on a scroll, and he shall wash them off into the bitter water.
verses.5:24: And he shall make the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and the water that brings a curse shall enter into her to produce bitterness.
verses.5:25: Then the priest shall take the grain offering of jealousy from the woman's hand, wave the grain offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.
verses.5:26: And the priest shall take a handful from the grain offering as its memorial portion and burn it upon the altar, and afterward he shall make the woman drink the water.
verses.5:27: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall be, if she has defiled herself and has acted unfaithfully against her husband, that the water that brings a curse shall enter into her to produce bitterness, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall waste away, and the woman shall become a curse in the midst of her people.
verses.5:28: But if the woman has not defiled herself, and she is clean, then she shall be free and shall be able to conceive children.
verses.5:29: This is the law of jealousy, when a wife turns aside while under her husband's authority and defiles herself,
verses.5:30: or when a spirit of jealousy comes upon a man and he becomes jealous of his wife; then he shall stand the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall carry out upon her all this law.
verses.5:31: Then the man shall be free from iniquity, but that woman shall bear her iniquity."
verses.6:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:2: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: When either a man or a woman makes a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,
verses.6:3: he shall abstain from wine and strong drink; he shall drink neither vinegar of wine nor vinegar of strong drink, nor shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.
verses.6:4: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is produced by the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.
verses.6:5: All the days of the vow of his separation no razor shall pass over his head; until the days are fulfilled for which he has separated himself to the LORD, he shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
verses.6:6: All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not approach a dead body.
verses.6:7: He shall not defile himself for his father or for his mother, for his brother or for his sister, when they die, because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
verses.6:8: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.
verses.6:9: And if anyone dies very suddenly beside him and he defiles his consecrated head, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he shall shave it.
verses.6:10: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.6:11: And the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering, and make atonement for him because he sinned concerning the dead body; and he shall sanctify his head on that day.
verses.6:12: And he shall consecrate to the LORD the days of his separation, and bring a male lamb of the first year as a trespass offering; but the former days shall be forfeited, because his separation was defiled.
verses.6:13: Now this is the law of the Nazirite: on the day when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.6:14: And he shall present his offering to the LORD: one male lamb of the first year without blemish as a burnt offering, one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish as a sin offering, one ram without blemish as a peace offering,
verses.6:15: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, with their grain offering and their drink offerings.
verses.6:16: Then the priest shall present them before the LORD and offer his sin offering and his burnt offering;
verses.6:17: and he shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, together with the basket of unleavened bread; the priest shall also offer its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.6:18: Then the Nazirite shall shave his consecrated head at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and shall take the hair from his consecrated head and put it on the fire that is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
verses.6:19: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder from the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and place them upon the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved off his consecrated hair.
verses.6:20: And the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before the LORD; it is holy for the priest, together with the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering. And afterward the Nazirite may drink wine.
verses.6:21: This is the law of the Nazirite who makes a vow, and of his offering to the LORD for his separation, besides whatever else he is able to provide; according to the vow which he takes, so he must do according to the law of his separation."
verses.6:22: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:23: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: Thus you shall bless the children of Israel, saying to them—and they shall place My name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them—
verses.6:24: 'May the LORD bless you and preserve you;
verses.6:25: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and show grace to you;
verses.6:26: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and grant you peace.'"

verses.8:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:2: "Speak to Aaron and say to him, 'When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps shall shine toward the front of the lampstand.'"
verses.8:3: And Aaron did so; he set up its lamps toward the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:4: Now this was the workmanship of the lampstand: hammered work of gold; from its base to its flowers, it was hammered work. According to the pattern that the LORD had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
verses.8:5: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:6: "Take the Levites from among the children of Israel and cleanse them.
verses.8:7: Thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: sprinkle water of purification upon them, and let them pass a razor over all their flesh, and wash their garments, and cleanse themselves.
verses.8:8: Then let them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and a second young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
verses.8:9: And you shall bring the Levites before the tent of meeting, and you shall assemble the entire congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.8:10: You shall bring the Levites before the LORD, and the children of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites.
verses.8:11: Then Aaron shall present the Levites as a wave offering before the LORD from the children of Israel, that they may perform the service of the LORD.
verses.8:12: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bulls; then offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.
verses.8:13: And you shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and present them as a wave offering to the LORD.
verses.8:14: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.8:15: After that the Levites shall enter to serve the tent of meeting; so you shall cleanse them and present them as a wave offering.
verses.8:16: For they are wholly given to Me from among the children of Israel; in place of all who open the womb, the firstborn of all from the children of Israel, I have taken them for Myself.
verses.8:17: For every firstborn among the children of Israel is Mine, both of man and of beast; on the day that I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated them to Myself.
verses.8:18: And I have taken the Levites in place of every firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.8:19: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to perform the service of the children of Israel in the tent of meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, that there may be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel draw near to the sanctuary."
verses.8:20: Thus Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel did to the Levites; according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
verses.8:21: And the Levites purified themselves from sin and washed their garments; then Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD, and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.8:22: And after that the Levites went in to perform their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and before his sons; just as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
verses.8:23: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:24: "This is what pertains to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward he shall enter to perform duty in the work of the tent of meeting;
verses.8:25: and from fifty years old he shall withdraw from the duty of the work and shall labor no more.
verses.8:26: He may assist his brethren in the tent of meeting to keep the charge, yet he shall do no labor. Thus you shall do with the Levites concerning their duties."
verses.9:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying,
verses.9:2: "Let the children of Israel observe the Passover at its appointed time.
verses.9:3: On the fourteenth day of this month, at twilight, you shall observe it at its appointed time; according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances you shall observe it."
verses.9:4: So Moses spoke to the children of Israel that they should observe the Passover.
verses.9:5: And they observed the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at twilight, in the Wilderness of Sinai; according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.
verses.9:6: Now there were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not observe the Passover on that day; and they drew near before Moses and before Aaron on that day.
verses.9:7: And those men said to him, "We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why should we be held back from presenting the offering of the LORD at its appointed time among the children of Israel?"
verses.9:8: And Moses said to them, "Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you."
verses.9:9: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.9:10: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'If any man among you or among your generations is unclean because of a dead body, or is on a distant journey, he shall still observe the Passover to the LORD.
verses.9:11: In the second month, on the fourteenth day, at twilight, they shall observe it; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it.
verses.9:12: They shall leave none of it until morning, nor break any bone of it; according to every statute of the Passover they shall observe it.
verses.9:13: But the man who is clean and is not on a journey, yet neglects to observe the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from among his people, because he did not present the offering of the LORD at its appointed time; that man shall bear his sin.
verses.9:14: And if a stranger sojourns among you and would observe the Passover to the LORD, according to the statute of the Passover and according to its ordinance, so he shall do; you shall have one statute, both for the stranger and for the native of the land.'"
verses.9:15: Now on the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the Testimony; and in the evening it was over the tabernacle like the appearance of fire until morning.
verses.9:16: So it was continually: the cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.9:17: And whenever the cloud was lifted up from above the tent, after that the children of Israel would set out; and in the place where the cloud settled, there the children of Israel would encamp.
verses.9:18: At the command of the LORD the children of Israel would set out, and at the command of the LORD they would encamp; all the days that the cloud rested upon the tabernacle, they would remain encamped.
verses.9:19: Even when the cloud lingered upon the tabernacle many days, the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD and did not set out.
verses.9:20: And sometimes the cloud was upon the tabernacle a few days; at the command of the LORD they would encamp, and at the command of the LORD they would set out.
verses.9:21: And sometimes the cloud remained from evening until morning; when the cloud was lifted up in the morning, then they would set out; or whether by day and by night, whenever the cloud was lifted up, they would set out.
verses.9:22: Whether two days, or a month, or a longer time that the cloud lingered upon the tabernacle, resting over it, the children of Israel would remain encamped and not set out; but when it was lifted up, they would set out.
verses.9:23: At the command of the LORD they encamped, and at the command of the LORD they set out; they kept the charge of the LORD, at the command of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.10:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.10:2: "Make for yourself two silver trumpets; of hammered work you shall make them, and they shall be for you for summoning the congregation and for moving the camps.
verses.10:3: When they blow both of them, all the congregation shall assemble to you at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.10:4: And if they blow only one, then the leaders, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall assemble to you.
verses.10:5: When you sound an alarm, the camps that are encamped on the east shall set out.
verses.10:6: When you sound an alarm a second time, the camps that are encamped on the south shall set out; they shall sound an alarm for their departures.
verses.10:7: Yet when gathering the assembly together, you shall blow the trumpets, but you shall not sound an alarm.
verses.10:8: The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and these shall be to you as a perpetual statute throughout your generations.
verses.10:9: And when you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, and you shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and you shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.10:10: Also in the day of your gladness, in your appointed feasts, and at the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be a memorial for you before your God: I am the LORD your God."
verses.10:11: Now it came to pass in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was lifted up from above the tabernacle of the Testimony.
verses.10:12: And the children of Israel set out on their journeys from the wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud settled in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.10:13: Thus they set out for the first time according to the command of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.10:14: The standard of the camp of the children of Judah set out first according to their hosts; and over its host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.10:15: Over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.10:16: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.10:17: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set out, carrying the tabernacle.
verses.10:18: Next the standard of the camp of Reuben set out according to their hosts; and over its host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.10:19: Over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.10:20: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.10:21: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the sacred things, while the tabernacle was set up before their arrival.
verses.10:22: Then the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set out according to their hosts; and over its host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.10:23: Over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.10:24: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.10:25: Then the standard of the camp of the children of Dan, the rear guard of all the camps, set out according to their hosts; and over its host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.10:26: Over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.10:27: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.10:28: Such was the order of march of the children of Israel according to their hosts, when they set out.
verses.10:29: Now Moses said to Hobab the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said, 'I will give it to you.' Come with us, and we will deal well with you, for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel."
verses.10:30: And he said to him, "I will not go, but I will depart to my own land and to my kindred."
verses.10:31: And he said, "Please do not leave us, since you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you shall be to us as eyes.
verses.10:32: And it shall be, if you go with us—indeed it shall be—that whatever good the LORD bestows upon us, that very good we will do to you."
verses.10:33: So they departed from the mountain of the LORD on a journey of three days; and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them for the three days' journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
verses.10:34: And it came to pass whenever the ark set out, that Moses said, "Arise, O LORD! Let Your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate You flee from before You."
verses.10:35: And when it rested, he said, "Return, O LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel."
verses.10:36: And the cloud of the LORD was above them by day whenever they set out from the camp.
verses.11:1: Now the people became like those who complain of misfortune in the hearing of the LORD; and the LORD heard it, and His wrath was kindled. So the fire of the LORD burned among them and consumed the outskirts of the camp.
verses.11:2: Then the people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire died down.
verses.11:3: So he called the name of that place Taberah, because the fire of the LORD had burned among them.
verses.11:4: Now the mixed multitude who were among them yielded to an intense craving; and the children of Israel also wept again and said, "Who will give us meat to eat?
verses.11:5: We remember the fish which we ate freely in Egypt, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic;
verses.11:6: but now our soul is dried up; there is nothing at all except this manna before our eyes!"
verses.11:7: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance was like the appearance of bdellium.
verses.11:8: The people went about and gathered it, ground it on millstones or beat it in a mortar, boiled it in a pot, and made cakes of it; and its taste was like the taste of pastry baked with oil.
verses.11:9: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.11:10: Then Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, each man at the doorway of his tent; and the wrath of the LORD was greatly kindled, and in the sight of Moses it was also grievous.
verses.11:11: So Moses said to the LORD, "Why have You dealt harshly with Your servant? And why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.11:12: Did I conceive all this people? Did I bring them forth, that You should say to me, 'Carry them in your bosom, as a guardian carries a nursing child,' to the land which You swore to their fathers?
verses.11:13: Where am I to get meat to give to all this people? For they weep before me, saying, 'Give us meat, that we may eat!'
verses.11:14: I am not able to bear all this people alone, for the burden is too heavy for me.
verses.11:15: And if You deal thus with me, please slay me at once—if I have found favor in Your sight—and do not let me look upon my own wretchedness."
verses.11:16: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Gather to Me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and their officers; bring them to the tent of meeting, and let them take their stand there with you.
verses.11:17: Then I will come down and speak with you there; and I will take of the Spirit that is upon you and put the same upon them, and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, so that you shall not bear it by yourself alone.
verses.11:18: And to the people you shall say, 'Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat meat; for you have wept in the hearing of the LORD, saying, "Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt." Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you shall eat.
verses.11:19: You shall eat not one day, nor two days, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days,
verses.11:20: but for a whole month, until it comes out of your nostrils and becomes loathsome to you, because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before Him, saying, "Why did we ever come forth from Egypt?"'"
verses.11:21: And Moses said, "The people among whom I am number six hundred thousand men on foot; yet You have said, 'I will give them meat, that they may eat for a whole month.'
verses.11:22: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?"
verses.11:23: And the LORD said to Moses, "Has the hand of the LORD been shortened? Now you shall see whether My word will come to pass for you or not."
verses.11:24: So Moses went out and spoke the words of the LORD to the people; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people and stationed them all around the tent.
verses.11:25: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was upon him and placed the same upon the seventy elders; and it came to pass, when the Spirit rested upon them, that they prophesied, though they did not do so again.
verses.11:26: Yet two men had remained in the camp—the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad—and the Spirit rested upon them. Now they were among those who were registered, though they had not gone out to the tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.11:27: And a young man ran and told Moses, and said, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
verses.11:28: Then Joshua the son of Nun, the attendant of Moses from his youth, answered and said, "My lord Moses, restrain them!"
verses.11:29: And Moses said to him, "Are you jealous for my sake? Oh, that all the LORD's people were prophets, and that the LORD would put His Spirit upon them!"
verses.11:30: Then Moses returned to the camp, both he and the elders of Israel.
verses.11:31: Now a wind went forth from the LORD and drove quail from the sea, and let them fall beside the camp, about a day's journey on this side and about a day's journey on the other side, all around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.
verses.11:32: And the people rose up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quail—he who gathered least gathered ten homers—and they spread them out all around the camp for themselves.
verses.11:33: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD struck the people with an exceedingly great plague.
verses.11:34: So he called the name of that place Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had yielded to craving.
verses.11:35: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people journeyed to Hazeroth, and they remained at Hazeroth.
verses.12:1: Then Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses on account of the Cushite woman whom he had married, for he had married a Cushite woman.
verses.12:2: And they said, "Has the LORD truly spoken only through Moses? Has He not spoken through us as well?" And the LORD heard it.
verses.12:3: Now the man Moses was exceedingly humble, more than all men who were on the face of the earth.
verses.12:4: Suddenly the LORD said to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, "Come out, the three of you, to the tent of meeting." So the three of them came out.
verses.12:5: Then the LORD descended in a pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the tent, and He called Aaron and Miriam, and the two of them stepped forward.
verses.12:6: And He said, "Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, make Myself known to him in a vision; in a dream I speak with him.
verses.12:7: Not so with My servant Moses; in all My house he is faithful.
verses.12:8: Mouth to mouth I speak with him, clearly and not in riddles, and he beholds the likeness of the LORD. Why then were you not afraid to speak against My servant, against Moses?"
verses.12:9: So the anger of the LORD burned against them, and He departed.
verses.12:10: And the cloud withdrew from above the tent, and behold, Miriam was leprous as snow. Then Aaron turned toward Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
verses.12:11: So Aaron said to Moses, "Oh, my lord, please do not lay sin upon us, for we have acted foolishly and we have sinned.
verses.12:12: Please do not let her be like one dead, whose flesh is already half consumed when he comes out of his mother's womb!"
verses.12:13: So Moses cried out to the LORD, saying, "Please, O God, please heal her!"
verses.12:14: Then the LORD said to Moses, "If her father had indeed spit in her face, would she not bear her shame for seven days? Let her be shut outside the camp for seven days, and afterward she shall be received back."
verses.12:15: So Miriam was shut outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not set out until Miriam was received back.
verses.12:16: Afterward the people journeyed from Hazeroth and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.13:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.13:2: "Send men for yourself to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel; from each tribe of their fathers you shall send one man, every one a leader among them."
verses.13:3: So Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran at the command of the LORD; all of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.13:4: Now these were their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
verses.13:5: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
verses.13:6: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
verses.13:7: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
verses.13:8: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;
verses.13:9: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
verses.13:10: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
verses.13:11: from the tribe of Joseph, namely from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;
verses.13:12: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;
verses.13:13: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
verses.13:14: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;
verses.13:15: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.13:16: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses gave Hoshea the son of Nun the name Joshua.
verses.13:17: Then Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, "Go up this way into the Negev, and ascend into the hill country,
verses.13:18: and observe what the land is like, and whether the people who dwell in it are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
verses.13:19: what the land is like in which they dwell, whether it is good or bad; and what the cities are like in which they dwell, whether in open camps or in strongholds;
verses.13:20: and what the land is like, whether it is rich or lean, and whether there are trees in it or not. Take courage, and bring back some of the fruit of the land." Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.
verses.13:21: So they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, near the entrance of Hamath.
verses.13:22: And they went up into the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, were. Now Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.
verses.13:23: Then they came to the Valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with a single cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a pole between two of them; they also brought some of the pomegranates and the figs.
verses.13:24: That place was named the Valley of Eshcol on account of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
verses.13:25: And they returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
verses.13:26: So they went and came to Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel in the wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.13:27: Then they recounted to him and said, "We went to the land where you sent us, and indeed it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
verses.13:28: Nevertheless, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and exceedingly great; moreover, we saw the descendants of Anak there.
verses.13:29: Amalek dwells in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the hill country; and the Canaanites dwell by the sea and along the banks of the Jordan."
verses.13:30: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, "Let us surely go up and possess it, for we are well able to overcome it."
verses.13:31: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we."
verses.13:32: And they spread an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, "The land through which we have passed to spy it out is a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people whom we saw in its midst are men of great stature.
verses.13:33: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim; and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight."
verses.14:1: Then all the congregation lifted up their voice and cried aloud, and the people wept that night.
verses.14:2: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them, "If only we had died in the land of Egypt! Or if only we had died in this wilderness!
verses.14:3: Why is the LORD bringing us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will become plunder! Would it not be better for us to return to Egypt?"
verses.14:4: And they said one to another, "Let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt."
verses.14:5: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.14:6: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their garments.
verses.14:7: And they spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, "The land through which we passed to spy it out is an exceedingly good land.
verses.14:8: If the LORD delights in us, then He will bring us into this land and give it to us, a land that flows with milk and honey.
verses.14:9: Only do not rebel against the LORD, nor fear the people of the land, for they are our bread; their protection has departed from them, and the LORD is with us. Do not fear them."
verses.14:10: And all the congregation spoke of stoning them with stones. Then the glory of the LORD appeared in the tent of meeting to all the children of Israel.
verses.14:11: And the LORD said to Moses, "How long will this people despise Me? And how long will they not believe in Me, in spite of all the signs that I have performed in their midst?
verses.14:12: I will strike them with the pestilence and disinherit them, and I will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they."
verses.14:13: And Moses said to the LORD, "Then the Egyptians will hear of it, for by Your might You brought up this people from among them,
verses.14:14: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that You, O LORD, are in the midst of this people, that You, O LORD, are seen face to face, and Your cloud stands over them, and You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.14:15: Now if You put this people to death as one man, then the nations who have heard of Your fame will speak, saying,
verses.14:16: 'Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which He swore to them, therefore He has slain them in the wilderness.'
verses.14:17: And now, I pray, let the power of the Lord be great, just as You have spoken, saying,
verses.14:18: 'The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in lovingkindness, forgiving iniquity and transgression, yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished, visiting the iniquity of fathers upon children to the third and the fourth generation.'
verses.14:19: Pardon, I pray, the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of Your lovingkindness, just as You have forgiven this people from Egypt even until now."
verses.14:20: Then the LORD said, "I have pardoned, according to your word.
verses.14:21: Yet truly, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD—
verses.14:22: indeed, all those men who have seen My glory and My signs that I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness, and yet have put Me to the test these ten times and have not listened to My voice,
verses.14:23: they shall by no means see the land that I swore to their fathers, nor shall any of those who despised Me see it.
verses.14:24: But My servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit in him and has followed Me fully, I will bring him into the land where he went, and his descendants shall possess it.
verses.14:25: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwell in the valley; tomorrow turn back and set out for the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea."
verses.14:26: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.14:27: "How long shall I bear with this evil congregation who murmur against Me? I have heard the murmurings that the children of Israel murmur against Me.
verses.14:28: Say to them, 'As I live,' declares the LORD, 'just as you have spoken in My hearing, so I will surely do to you:
verses.14:29: Your corpses shall fall in this wilderness, even all who were numbered among you, according to your entire number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against Me.
verses.14:30: You shall by no means enter the land concerning which I lifted up My hand to make you dwell in it, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.14:31: But your little ones, whom you said would become plunder, I will bring in, and they shall know the land that you have rejected.
verses.14:32: Yet as for you, your corpses shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.14:33: And your children shall be shepherds in the wilderness forty years and bear your unfaithfulness, until your corpses are consumed in the wilderness.
verses.14:34: According to the number of the days in which you spied out the land, forty days, a year for each day, you shall bear your iniquities forty years, and you shall know My displeasure.
verses.14:35: I, the LORD, have spoken. Surely this I will do to all this evil congregation who have gathered together against Me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.'"
verses.14:36: Now the men whom Moses had sent to spy out the land, who returned and caused all the congregation to murmur against him by spreading a bad report about the land,
verses.14:37: those very men who brought forth the evil report about the land died by the plague before the LORD.
verses.14:38: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who had gone to spy out the land.
verses.14:39: Then Moses spoke these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
verses.14:40: And they rose early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, "Here we are, and we will go up to the place that the LORD has promised, for we have sinned."
verses.14:41: And Moses said, "Why now are you transgressing the command of the LORD? For it will not succeed.
verses.14:42: Do not go up, for the LORD is not in your midst, lest you be defeated before your enemies.
verses.14:43: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword; because you have turned back from following the LORD, the LORD will not be with you."
verses.14:44: Yet they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain; nevertheless, neither the ark of the covenant of the LORD nor Moses departed from the midst of the camp.
verses.14:45: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who dwelt in that mountain came down and struck them and beat them back as far as Hormah.
verses.15:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.15:2: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, 'When you come into the land of your dwellings, which I am giving to you,
verses.15:3: and you prepare an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a special vow or as a freewill offering or at your appointed feasts, to make a pleasing aroma to the LORD from the herd or from the flock,
verses.15:4: then the one who presents his offering to the LORD shall bring a grain offering of one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mingled with one-fourth of a hin of oil;
verses.15:5: and one-fourth of a hin of wine for a drink offering you shall prepare with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
verses.15:6: Or for a ram you shall prepare as a grain offering two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, mingled with one-third of a hin of oil;
verses.15:7: and for a drink offering you shall present one-third of a hin of wine, as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.15:8: And when you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a special vow or as peace offerings to the LORD,
verses.15:9: then he shall present with the young bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, mingled with half a hin of oil;
verses.15:10: and you shall present half a hin of wine for the drink offering, as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.15:11: Thus it shall be done for each ox, or for each ram, or for each young one among the sheep or among the goats.
verses.15:12: According to the number that you prepare, so you shall do for each one according to their number.
verses.15:13: Every native-born person shall do these things in this manner, in presenting an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.15:14: And if a stranger sojourns with you, or whoever is in your midst throughout your generations, and would prepare an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD, just as you do, so he shall do.
verses.15:15: As for the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the sojourning stranger, a perpetual statute throughout your generations; as you are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
verses.15:16: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who sojourns with you.'"
verses.15:17: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.15:18: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, 'When you come into the land to which I am bringing you,
verses.15:19: then it shall be, when you eat of the bread of the land, that you shall lift up a heave offering to the LORD.
verses.15:20: Of the first of your dough you shall lift up a cake as a heave offering; as the heave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall lift it up.
verses.15:21: From the first of your dough you shall give to the LORD a heave offering throughout your generations.
verses.15:22: Now if you err unintentionally, and do not observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses—
verses.15:23: all that the LORD has commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—
verses.15:24: then it shall be, if it was committed unintentionally, hidden from the eyes of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, as a pleasing aroma to the LORD, with its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.
verses.15:25: And the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, for it was an unintentional error; and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their unintentional error.
verses.15:26: It shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel and the stranger who sojourns in their midst, because all the people acted in unintentional error.
verses.15:27: And if one person sins unintentionally, then he shall present a female goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.15:28: So the priest shall make atonement for the person who erred, when he sins unintentionally before the LORD, to make atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.15:29: For the native-born among the children of Israel and for the stranger who sojourns in their midst, you shall have one law for him who acts unintentionally.
verses.15:30: But the person who acts with a high hand, whether native-born or stranger, he blasphemes the LORD, and that person shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.15:31: Because he has despised the word of the LORD, and has broken His commandment, that person shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.'"
verses.15:32: Now while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
verses.15:33: And those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
verses.15:34: They placed him under guard, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
verses.15:35: Then the LORD said to Moses, "The man shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp."
verses.15:36: So all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him with stones, and he died, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.15:37: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.15:38: "Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them to make tassels for themselves on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and to put a cord of blue upon the tassel of each corner.
verses.15:39: And it shall be a tassel for you, that you may look upon it and remember all the commandments of the LORD and do them, and not go seeking after your own heart and your own eyes, after which you play the harlot;
verses.15:40: so that you may remember and do all My commandments, and be holy to your God.
verses.15:41: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God; I am the LORD your God."
verses.16:1: Now Korah the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, took Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, and On the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben;
verses.16:2: and they rose up before Moses with two hundred and fifty men of the children of Israel, leaders of the congregation, summoned to the assembly, men of renown.
verses.16:3: And they assembled themselves against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, "You have gone too far! For all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is in their midst. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD?"
verses.16:4: When Moses heard this, he fell upon his face.
verses.16:5: Then he spoke to Korah and to all his company, saying, "In the morning the LORD will make known who is His and who is holy, and will bring him near to Himself; indeed, the one whom He chooses He will bring near to Himself.
verses.16:6: Do this: take censers for yourselves, Korah and all his company,
verses.16:7: and put fire in them and place incense upon them before the LORD tomorrow; and it shall be that the man whom the LORD chooses, he is the holy one. You have gone too far, O sons of Levi!"
verses.16:8: Then Moses said to Korah, "Hear now, O sons of Levi:
verses.16:9: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to Himself, to perform the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them,
verses.16:10: and that He has brought you near, and all your brethren, the sons of Levi, with you? And do you seek the priesthood also?
verses.16:11: Therefore you and all your company are gathered together against the LORD. And what is Aaron, that you murmur against him?"
verses.16:12: Then Moses sent to summon Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab; and they said, "We will not come up!
verses.16:13: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to put us to death in the wilderness, that you must also make yourself altogether a ruler over us?
verses.16:14: Moreover, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up!"
verses.16:15: Then Moses was exceedingly angry, and said to the LORD, "Do not regard their offering! I have not taken a single donkey from them, nor have I harmed any one of them."
verses.16:16: And Moses said to Korah, "You and all your company, be present before the LORD tomorrow—you and they, and Aaron.
verses.16:17: Let each man take his censer, and put incense upon them, and bring before the LORD each man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; you also and Aaron, each man his censer."
verses.16:18: So each man took his censer, put fire in them, laid incense upon them, and stood at the entrance of the tent of meeting, with Moses and Aaron.
verses.16:19: And Korah assembled all the congregation against them at the entrance of the tent of meeting. Then the glory of the LORD appeared to all the congregation.
verses.16:20: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.16:21: "Separate yourselves from the midst of this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment."
verses.16:22: Then they fell upon their faces and said, "O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will You be angry with all the congregation?"
verses.16:23: So the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.16:24: "Speak to the congregation, saying, 'Withdraw from all around the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.'"
verses.16:25: Then Moses arose and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.16:26: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, "Depart now from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing that belongs to them, lest you be swept away in all their sins."
verses.16:27: So they withdrew from all around the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram; and Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the entrance of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
verses.16:28: Then Moses said, "By this you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works, for I have not done them from my own heart:
verses.16:29: If these men die as all men die, or if they are visited after the fate of all men, then the LORD has not sent me.
verses.16:30: But if the LORD creates a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth and swallows them up with all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall know that these men have despised the LORD."
