verses.16:31: Now it came to pass, as soon as he had finished speaking all these words, that the ground beneath them split apart,
verses.16:32: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households and all the people who belonged to Korah, and all their possessions.
verses.16:33: So they and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol; and the earth closed over them, and they perished from the midst of the assembly.
verses.16:34: And all Israel who were round about them fled at their outcry, for they said, "Lest the earth swallow us up!"
verses.16:35: And fire came forth from the LORD and consumed the two hundred and fifty men who were offering the incense.
verses.17:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17:2: "Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he lift up the censers from the midst of the burning, and scatter the fire far away, for they are holy.
verses.17:3: As for the censers of these men who sinned at the cost of their own lives, let them make them into hammered plates as a covering for the altar, for they offered them before the LORD, and they became holy; and they shall be a sign to the children of Israel."
verses.17:4: So Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered, and they hammered them out as a covering for the altar,
verses.17:5: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, so that no outsider who is not of the seed of Aaron should draw near to burn incense before the LORD, and that he might not become like Korah and his company—just as the LORD had spoken to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.17:6: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, "You have killed the people of the LORD!"
verses.17:7: Now it came to pass, when the congregation gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they turned toward the tent of meeting; and behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
verses.17:8: Then Moses and Aaron came before the tent of meeting.
verses.17:9: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17:10: "Get away from the midst of this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment." And they fell upon their faces.
verses.17:11: So Moses said to Aaron, "Take the censer, and put fire in it from off the altar, and lay incense on it, and carry it swiftly to the congregation and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone forth from before the LORD. The plague has begun!"
verses.17:12: Then Aaron took it just as Moses had spoken, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and behold, the plague had already begun among the people. So he put on the incense and made atonement for the people.
verses.17:13: And he stood between the dead and the living, and the plague was stayed.
verses.17:14: Now those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died in the matter of Korah.
verses.17:15: So Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the tent of meeting, for the plague had been stayed.
verses.17:16: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17:17: "Speak to the children of Israel, and take from them a rod for each father's house, from all their leaders according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods. You shall write each man's name upon his rod.
verses.17:18: And you shall write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi, for there shall be one rod for the head of each of their fathers' houses.
verses.17:19: Then you shall place them in the tent of meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.
verses.17:20: And it shall be that the rod of the man whom I choose will blossom; thus I will rid Myself of the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you."
verses.17:21: So Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and all their leaders gave him a rod apiece, for each leader one rod according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods; and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
verses.17:22: And Moses placed the rods before the LORD in the tent of the testimony.
verses.17:23: Now it came to pass on the next day that Moses went into the tent of the testimony, and behold, the rod of Aaron, of the house of Levi, had sprouted and put forth buds, produced blossoms, and borne ripe almonds.
verses.17:24: Then Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel; and they looked, and each man took his rod.
verses.17:25: And the LORD said to Moses, "Bring Aaron's rod back before the testimony, to be kept as a sign for the sons of rebellion, that you may put an end to their murmurings against Me, lest they die."
verses.17:26: Thus Moses did; just as the LORD had commanded him, so he did.
verses.17:27: Then the children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, "Behold, we die! We perish! We all perish!
verses.17:28: Everyone who comes near—everyone who comes near to the tabernacle of the LORD—shall die! Shall we all perish completely?"
verses.18:1: Then the LORD said to Aaron: "You and your sons and your father's house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.18:2: Also bring near with you your brethren of the tribe of Levi, your father's tribe, that they may be joined to you and minister to you, while you and your sons with you are before the tent of the Testimony.
verses.18:3: They shall keep your charge and the charge of all the tent; only they shall not draw near to the vessels of the sanctuary or to the altar, lest both they and you die.
verses.18:4: They shall be joined to you and keep the charge of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the tent; and no outsider shall draw near to you.
verses.18:5: And you shall keep the charge of the sanctuary and the charge of the altar, so that there may be no more wrath upon the children of Israel.
verses.18:6: Behold, I Myself have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel; they are a gift to you, given to the LORD, to perform the service of the tent of meeting.
verses.18:7: Therefore you and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for every matter of the altar and for what is within the veil, and you shall serve. I give your priesthood as a service of gift, and the outsider who draws near shall be put to death."
verses.18:8: And the LORD spoke to Aaron: "Behold, I Myself have given you the charge of My heave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel; to you I have given them by virtue of the anointing, and to your sons as a perpetual statute.
verses.18:9: This shall be yours of the most holy things kept from the fire: every offering of theirs—every grain offering of theirs, every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they render to Me—shall be most holy for you and for your sons.
verses.18:10: In a most holy place you shall eat it; every male may eat it; it shall be holy to you.
verses.18:11: This also is yours: the heave offering of their gift, along with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel; I have given them to you, and to your sons and your daughters with you, as a perpetual statute. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
verses.18:12: All the choicest of the oil and all the choicest of the new wine and the grain, their firstfruits which they give to the LORD, I have given to you.
verses.18:13: The first ripe produce of all that is in their land, which they bring to the LORD, shall be yours; everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
verses.18:14: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.
verses.18:15: Everything that first opens the womb of all flesh, which they present to the LORD, whether of man or of beast, shall be yours; nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of an unclean beast you shall redeem.
verses.18:16: And those to be redeemed among them you shall redeem from a month old, according to your valuation, for five shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
verses.18:17: But the firstborn of an ox, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat, you shall not redeem; they are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and their fat you shall burn as an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma to the LORD.
verses.18:18: And their flesh shall be yours; just as the wave breast and the right thigh, it shall be yours.
verses.18:19: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel present to the LORD, I have given to you and to your sons and your daughters with you as a perpetual statute; it is an everlasting covenant of salt before the LORD for you and for your descendants with you."
verses.18:20: Then the LORD said to Aaron: "In their land you shall have no inheritance, nor shall you have any portion among them; I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.18:21: Behold, to the sons of Levi I have given every tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they perform, the service of the tent of meeting.
verses.18:22: And the children of Israel shall no longer draw near to the tent of meeting, lest they bear sin and die.
verses.18:23: But the Levites themselves shall perform the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity; it shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they shall possess no inheritance.
verses.18:24: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they lift up as a heave offering to the LORD, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance; therefore I have said to them, 'Among the children of Israel they shall possess no inheritance.'"
verses.18:25: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.18:26: "Speak also to the Levites, and say to them: 'When you receive from the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them as your inheritance, then you shall lift up from it a heave offering to the LORD, a tithe of the tithe.
verses.18:27: And your heave offering shall be reckoned to you as the grain from the threshing floor and as the fullness from the winepress.
verses.18:28: Thus you also shall lift up a heave offering to the LORD from all your tithes which you receive from the children of Israel, and from it you shall give the LORD's heave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.18:29: Out of all your gifts you shall lift up every heave offering of the LORD, from all the best of it, even the consecrated part of it.'
verses.18:30: And you shall say to them: 'When you have lifted up the best of it from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites as the produce of the threshing floor and as the produce of the winepress.
verses.18:31: And you may eat it in any place, you and your household, for it is your wages in return for your service in the tent of meeting.
verses.18:32: And you shall bear no sin because of it when you have lifted up the best of it from it; neither shall you profane the holy things of the children of Israel, lest you die.'"
verses.19:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.19:2: "This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded, saying: 'Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring to you a red heifer without blemish, in which there is no defect, and upon which a yoke has never come.
verses.19:3: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside the camp, and one shall slaughter her before him.
verses.19:4: And Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle some of her blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.
verses.19:5: Then one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her hide, her flesh, and her blood, together with her dung, he shall burn.
verses.19:6: And the priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.19:7: Then the priest shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp; and the priest shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:8: And the one who burns her shall wash his garments in water and bathe his body in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:9: Then a clean man shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place; and they shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for the water of purification; it is a sin offering.
verses.19:10: And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening. It shall be a perpetual statute for the children of Israel and for the sojourner who dwells among them.
verses.19:11: He who touches the dead body of any person shall be unclean seven days.
verses.19:12: He shall purify himself with it on the third day and on the seventh day, and he shall be clean; but if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he shall not be clean.
verses.19:13: Whoever touches a corpse, the body of any person who has died, and does not purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water of purification was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is still upon him.
verses.19:14: This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who enters the tent and all that is in the tent shall be unclean seven days.
verses.19:15: And every open vessel which has no covering tied fast upon it is unclean.
verses.19:16: And whoever in the open field touches one slain by the sword, or a dead body, or a human bone, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.19:17: And for the unclean person they shall take some of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering, and living water shall be poured upon them into a vessel.
verses.19:18: Then a clean man shall take hyssop and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, upon all the vessels, and upon the persons who were there, and upon the one who touched a bone, or one slain, or the dead, or a grave.
verses.19:19: And the clean person shall sprinkle the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day; and on the seventh day he shall purify him, and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and at evening he shall be clean.
verses.19:20: But the man who becomes unclean and does not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD; the water of purification has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
verses.19:21: And it shall be a perpetual statute for them. He who sprinkles the water of purification shall wash his garments, and he who touches the water of purification shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:22: And whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean, and the person who touches it shall be unclean until evening.'"
verses.20:1: Then the children of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people dwelt in Kadesh; and Miriam died there and was buried there.
verses.20:2: Now there was no water for the congregation; so they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.20:3: And the people contended with Moses and spoke, saying, "If only we had perished when our brethren perished before the LORD!
verses.20:4: Why have you brought the assembly of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our livestock should die there?
verses.20:5: And why have you brought us up out of Egypt to bring us to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; nor is there any water to drink."
verses.20:6: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance of the tabernacle of meeting, and they fell on their faces; and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
verses.20:7: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.20:8: "Take the rod, and you and Aaron your brother gather the congregation together, and speak to the rock before their eyes, and it shall yield its water; thus you shall bring forth water for them out of the rock, and give drink to the congregation and their livestock."
verses.20:9: So Moses took the rod from before the LORD, just as He had commanded him.
verses.20:10: And Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock; and he said to them, "Hear now, you rebels! Must we bring forth water for you out of this rock?"
verses.20:11: Then Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock twice with his rod; and water came forth abundantly, and the congregation and their livestock drank.
verses.20:12: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not believe Me, to hallow Me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them."
verses.20:13: These were the waters of Meribah, because the children of Israel contended with the LORD, and He was hallowed among them.
verses.20:14: Now Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom: "Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the hardship that has befallen us,
verses.20:15: how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt many days, and the Egyptians dealt evilly with us and with our fathers.
verses.20:16: And when we cried out to the LORD, He heard our voice and sent an angel and brought us forth out of Egypt; and behold, we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your border.
verses.20:17: Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or vineyard, nor will we drink water from any well; we will go along the King's Highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your border."
verses.20:18: Then Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through my land, lest I come out against you with the sword."
verses.20:19: So the children of Israel said to him, "We will go up by the highway, and if I or my livestock drink of your water, then I will pay its price; only let me pass through on foot, nothing more."
verses.20:20: And he said, "You shall not pass through." So Edom came out against him with a great multitude and with a strong hand.
verses.20:21: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border; therefore Israel turned away from him.
verses.20:22: Now the children of Israel, the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.
verses.20:23: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.20:24: "Aaron shall be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against My word at the waters of Meribah.
verses.20:25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;
verses.20:26: and strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron shall be gathered and shall die there."
verses.20:27: So Moses did just as the LORD commanded, and they went up to Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.20:28: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
verses.20:29: Now when all the congregation saw that Aaron had perished, all the house of Israel wept for Aaron thirty days.
verses.21:1: Now the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim; and he fought against Israel and took some of them captive.
verses.21:2: Then Israel vowed a vow to the LORD and said, "If You will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities."
verses.21:3: And the LORD listened to the voice of Israel and delivered up the Canaanites, and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. So the name of the place was called Hormah.
verses.21:4: Then they journeyed from Mount Hor by the way of the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom; and the soul of the people grew impatient along the way.
verses.21:5: And the people spoke against God and against Moses: "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread and no water, and our soul loathes this worthless bread."
verses.21:6: So the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many of the people of Israel died.
verses.21:7: Therefore the people came to Moses and said, "We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD and against you; pray to the LORD that He take away the serpents from us." So Moses prayed for the people.
verses.21:8: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Make for yourself a fiery serpent and set it on a pole; and it shall be that everyone who is bitten, when he looks upon it, shall live."
verses.21:9: So Moses made a serpent of bronze and set it on the pole; and it came to pass that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of bronze, he lived.
verses.21:10: Now the children of Israel journeyed on and encamped in Oboth.
verses.21:11: And they journeyed from Oboth and encamped at Iye-Abarim, in the wilderness that is before Moab, toward the rising of the sun.
verses.21:12: From there they journeyed and encamped in the Valley of Zered.
verses.21:13: From there they journeyed and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that extends from the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.21:14: Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of the LORD: "Waheb in Suphah, and the valleys of the Arnon,
verses.21:15: and the slope of the valleys that reaches to the dwelling of Ar, and leans upon the border of Moab."
verses.21:16: And from there they went to Beer, which is the well concerning which the LORD spoke to Moses, "Gather the people together, and I will give them water."
verses.21:17: Then Israel sang this song: "Spring up, O well! Sing to it:
verses.21:18: The well which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people sank, with the scepter and with their staffs." And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah,
verses.21:19: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
verses.21:20: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down upon the wasteland.
verses.21:21: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.21:22: "Let me pass through your land. We will not turn aside into field or vineyard; we will not drink water from any well; we will go along the King's Highway until we have passed through your border."
verses.21:23: But Sihon would not permit Israel to pass through his border. So Sihon gathered all his people together and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and he came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.
verses.21:24: Then Israel struck him with the edge of the sword and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.21:25: So Israel took all these cities, and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and in all its villages.
verses.21:26: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and taken all his land out of his hand, as far as the Arnon.
verses.21:27: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say: "Come to Heshbon, let it be built; let the city of Sihon be established.
verses.21:28: For fire went forth from Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon; it has consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the heights of the Arnon.
verses.21:29: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, O people of Chemosh; he has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.21:30: We have shot at them; Heshbon has perished as far as Dibon, and we have laid waste as far as Nophah, which reaches to Medeba."
verses.21:31: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.21:32: Then Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they captured its villages, and he drove out the Amorites who were there.
verses.21:33: And they turned and went up by the way to Bashan. So Og king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.21:34: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people and his land; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon."
verses.21:35: So they struck him down, and his sons, and all his people, until there was no survivor left to him; and they took possession of his land.
verses.22:1: Then the children of Israel set out and encamped in the plains of Moab, across the Jordan from Jericho.
verses.22:2: Now Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.22:3: And Moab was exceedingly afraid of the people, because they were numerous; and Moab was struck with dread because of the children of Israel.
verses.22:4: So Moab said to the elders of Midian, "Now this assembly will lick up all that is around us, as an ox licks up the green grass of the field." And Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
verses.22:5: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor at Pethor, which is by the River, in the land of the children of his people, to summon him, saying, "Behold, a people has come out of Egypt; behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they are dwelling opposite me.
verses.22:6: Now therefore, please come and curse this people for me, for they are mightier than I. Perhaps I may prevail, that we may strike them and I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed."
verses.22:7: So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the fees for divination in their hand; and they came to Balaam and spoke to him the words of Balak.
verses.22:8: And he said to them, "Lodge here tonight, and I will bring back word to you, as the LORD speaks to me." So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
verses.22:9: Then God came to Balaam and said, "Who are these men with you?"
verses.22:10: And Balaam said to God, "Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me:
verses.22:11: 'Behold, the people who came out of Egypt have covered the face of the earth. Now come, curse them for me; perhaps I shall be able to make war against them and drive them out.'"
verses.22:12: And God said to Balaam, "You shall not go with them; you shall not curse the people, for they are blessed."
verses.22:13: So Balaam rose in the morning and said to the princes of Balak, "Go back to your land, for the LORD has refused to permit me to go with you."
verses.22:14: And the princes of Moab arose and went to Balak, and said, "Balaam refused to come with us."
verses.22:15: Then Balak again sent princes, more numerous and more honorable than these.
verses.22:16: And they came to Balaam and said to him, "Thus says Balak the son of Zippor: 'Please do not hold back from coming to me,
verses.22:17: for I will surely honor you exceedingly, and all that you say to me I will do; come now, therefore, and curse this people for me.'"
verses.22:18: Then Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, "Though Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the command of the LORD my God, to do anything small or great.
verses.22:19: Now therefore, please remain here tonight as well, that I may learn what more the LORD will speak with me."
verses.22:20: And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, "If the men have come to summon you, rise and go with them; yet only the word which I speak to you—that you shall do."
verses.22:21: So Balaam rose in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.22:22: Then the anger of God was kindled because he was going, and the Angel of the LORD took His stand in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
verses.22:23: And the donkey saw the Angel of the LORD standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand; so the donkey turned aside out of the way and went into the field. And Balaam struck the donkey to turn her back onto the road.
verses.22:24: Then the Angel of the LORD stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, with a wall on this side and a wall on that side.
verses.22:25: When the donkey saw the Angel of the LORD, she pressed herself against the wall and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall; so he struck her again.
verses.22:26: Then the Angel of the LORD went further and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn to the right hand or to the left.
verses.22:27: And the donkey saw the Angel of the LORD, and she lay down under Balaam; so Balaam's anger was kindled, and he struck the donkey with the staff.
verses.22:28: Then the LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?"
verses.22:29: And Balaam said to the donkey, "Because you have made a mockery of me! If there were a sword in my hand, I would slay you right now!"
verses.22:30: So the donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your donkey on which you have ridden all your life to this day? Have I ever been accustomed to do thus to you?" And he said, "No."
verses.22:31: Then the LORD uncovered the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the Angel of the LORD standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand; and he bowed down and prostrated himself on his face.
verses.22:32: And the Angel of the LORD said to him, "Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come forth as an adversary, because the way is perverse before Me.
verses.22:33: And the donkey saw Me and turned aside before Me these three times. Unless she had turned aside from before Me, surely by now I would have slain you indeed, and let her live."
verses.22:34: Then Balaam said to the Angel of the LORD, "I have sinned, for I did not know that You stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it is evil in Your sight, I will turn back."
verses.22:35: And the Angel of the LORD said to Balaam, "Go with the men, yet only the word that I speak to you—that you shall speak." So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.22:36: Now when Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him at the city of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, at the farthest edge of the territory.
verses.22:37: And Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not earnestly send to you to summon you? Why did you not come to me? Am I truly unable to honor you?"
verses.22:38: And Balaam said to Balak, "Behold, I have come to you! Now have I any power at all to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that I shall speak."
verses.22:39: So Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.
verses.22:40: Then Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and sent some to Balaam and to the princes who were with him.
verses.22:41: And it came to pass in the morning that Balak took Balaam and brought him up to the high places of Baal, and from there he saw the outskirts of the people.
verses.23:1: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams."
verses.23:2: And Balak did just as Balaam had spoken, and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.23:3: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go; perhaps the LORD will come to meet me, and whatever He shows me I will declare to you." So he went to a bare height.
verses.23:4: And God met Balaam, and he said to Him, "I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered on each altar a bull and a ram."
verses.23:5: Then the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, "Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak."
verses.23:6: So he returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he and all the princes of Moab.
verses.23:7: And he took up his oracle and said: "From Aram Balak has brought me, the king of Moab, from the mountains of the east: 'Come, curse Jacob for me, and come, denounce Israel!'
verses.23:8: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? And how shall I denounce whom the LORD has not denounced?
verses.23:9: For from the summit of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him; behold, a people dwelling alone, and not reckoning itself among the nations.
verses.23:10: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or number the fourth part of Israel? Let my soul die the death of the upright, and let my latter end be like his!"
verses.23:11: Then Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have surely blessed them!"
verses.23:12: So he answered and said, "Must I not take heed to speak what the LORD puts in my mouth?"
verses.23:13: Then Balak said to him, "Please come with me to another place from which you may see them; you shall see only the outskirts of them, and you shall not see all of them; and curse them for me from there."
verses.23:14: So he brought him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.23:15: And he said to Balak, "Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet Him over there."
verses.23:16: Then the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, "Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak."
verses.23:17: So he came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab were with him. And Balak said to him, "What has the LORD spoken?"
verses.23:18: Then he took up his oracle and said: "Rise up, Balak, and hear! Give ear to me, O son of Zippor!
verses.23:19: God is not a man, that He should lie, nor a son of man, that He should relent. Has He said, and will He not perform it? Or has He spoken, and will He not establish it?
verses.23:20: Behold, I have received a charge to bless; He has blessed, and I cannot reverse it.
verses.23:21: He has not beheld iniquity in Jacob, nor has He seen trouble in Israel. The LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a King is in his midst.
verses.23:22: God brings them out of Egypt; they have strength like that of a wild ox.
verses.23:23: For there is no enchantment against Jacob, nor is there any divination against Israel. At this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, 'What God has wrought!'
verses.23:24: Behold, a people rises like a lioness, and lifts itself up like a lion; it shall not lie down until it devours the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain."
verses.23:25: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all!"
verses.23:26: So Balaam answered and said to Balak, "Did I not speak to you, saying, 'All that the LORD speaks, that I shall do'?"
verses.23:27: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Please come, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will be right in the sight of God, and you shall curse them for me from there."
verses.23:28: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the face of the wasteland.
verses.23:29: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams."
verses.23:30: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.24:1: And Balaam saw that it was good in the sight of the LORD to bless Israel, so he did not go, as at previous times, to meet with omens, but set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.24:2: And Balaam lifted up his eyes and saw Israel dwelling according to its tribes, and the Spirit of God was upon him.
verses.24:3: Then he took up his oracle and said, "The utterance of Balaam the son of Beor, even the utterance of the man whose eye is opened,
verses.24:4: the utterance of him who hears the sayings of God, who beholds the vision of the Almighty, falling down, yet with eyes uncovered:
verses.24:5: How fair are your tents, O Jacob, your habitations, O Israel!
verses.24:6: Like valleys that stretch forth, like gardens beside a river, like aloes which the LORD has planted, like cedars beside the waters.
verses.24:7: Water shall flow from his buckets, and his seed shall be in abundant waters; his king shall be exalted above Agag, and his kingdom shall be lifted high.
verses.24:8: God brings him forth out of Egypt; he has strength like the wild ox. He shall devour the nations, his adversaries; he shall crush their bones and pierce them through with his arrows.
verses.24:9: He crouches, he lies down like a lion, and like a lioness—who shall rouse him? Blessed is everyone who blesses you, and cursed is everyone who curses you."
verses.24:10: Then the anger of Balak burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, "I summoned you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have surely blessed them these three times.
verses.24:11: Now therefore, flee to your own place! I said I would greatly honor you, yet behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor."
verses.24:12: And Balaam said to Balak, "Did I not also speak to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
verses.24:13: 'If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not transgress the command of the LORD, to do good or evil of my own heart; what the LORD speaks, that I must speak.'
verses.24:14: And now, behold, I am going to my people. Come, I will counsel you concerning what this people shall do to your people in the latter days."
verses.24:15: Then he took up his oracle and said, "The utterance of Balaam the son of Beor, even the utterance of the man whose eye is opened,
verses.24:16: the utterance of him who hears the sayings of God, and knows the knowledge of the Most High, who beholds the vision of the Almighty, falling down, yet with eyes uncovered:
verses.24:17: I see him, yet not now; I behold him, yet not near: a Star shall come forth from Jacob, and a Scepter shall rise out of Israel, and shall crush the brow of Moab and tear down all the sons of Sheth.
verses.24:18: And Edom shall become a possession, and Seir also, his enemies, shall become a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
verses.24:19: Out of Jacob one shall exercise dominion, and shall destroy the survivor from the city."
verses.24:20: Then he looked on Amalek, and took up his oracle and said, "Amalek was first among the nations, but his latter end shall be destruction."
verses.24:21: Then he looked on the Kenites, and took up his oracle and said, "Enduring is your dwelling place, and your nest is set in the crag;
verses.24:22: nevertheless Kain shall be laid waste; how long until Asshur carries you away captive?"
verses.24:23: Then he took up his oracle and said, "Alas, who shall live when God ordains this?
verses.24:24: Yet ships shall come from the coast of Kittim, and they shall afflict Asshur and afflict Eber; and he also shall come to destruction."
verses.24:25: Then Balaam arose and departed, and returned to his place; and Balak also went on his way.
verses.25:1: Now Israel dwelt in Shittim, and the people began to commit harlotry with the daughters of Moab.
verses.25:2: They invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods, and the people ate and bowed down to their gods.
verses.25:3: So Israel yoked itself to Baal of Peor, and the anger of the LORD burned against Israel.
verses.25:4: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Take all the heads of the people and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel."
verses.25:5: So Moses said to the judges of Israel, "Each of you, slay his men who have yoked themselves to Baal of Peor."
verses.25:6: And behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brethren a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.25:7: When Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he arose from the midst of the congregation and took a spear in his hand;
verses.25:8: and he went after the man of Israel into the inner tent and pierced both of them through, the man of Israel and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.25:9: And those who died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
verses.25:10: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.25:11: "Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned back My wrath from the children of Israel, because he was zealous with My zeal in their midst, so that I did not consume the children of Israel in My zeal.
verses.25:12: Therefore say, 'Behold, I give to him My covenant of peace;
verses.25:13: and it shall be to him and to his seed after him a covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the children of Israel.'"
verses.25:14: Now the name of the slain man of Israel, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri the son of Salu, a leader of a father's house among the Simeonites.
verses.25:15: And the name of the slain Midianite woman was Cozbi the daughter of Zur; he was head of the peoples of a father's house in Midian.
verses.25:16: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.25:17: "Harass the Midianites and strike them down,
verses.25:18: for they have been hostile to you with their wiles by which they deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a leader of Midian, their sister, who was slain in the day of the plague because of Peor."
verses.26:1: And it came to pass, after the plague, that the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.26:2: "Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers' houses, everyone who is able to go forth to war in Israel."
verses.26:3: So Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.26:4: "From twenty years old and upward," just as the LORD had commanded Moses. Now the children of Israel who came forth from the land of Egypt were these:
verses.26:5: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. The sons of Reuben were: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
verses.26:6: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.26:7: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.26:8: And the son of Pallu was Eliab.
verses.26:9: The sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, chosen men of the congregation, who contended against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they contended against the LORD.
verses.26:10: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died, at the time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men; and they became a warning sign.
verses.26:11: Yet the sons of Korah did not die.
verses.26:12: The sons of Simeon according to their families were: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
verses.26:13: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
verses.26:14: These are the families of the Simeonites: twenty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.26:15: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.26:16: And the sons of Judah according to their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
verses.26:17: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
verses.26:18: These are the families of Judah according to those who were numbered of them: seventy-six thousand five hundred.
verses.26:19: The sons of Issachar according to their families were: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
verses.26:20: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
verses.26:21: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were numbered of them: sixty-four thousand three hundred.
verses.26:22: The sons of Zebulun according to their families were: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.26:23: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were numbered of them: sixty thousand five hundred.
verses.26:24: The sons of Gad according to their families were: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
verses.26:25: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
verses.26:26: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
verses.26:27: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were numbered of them: forty thousand five hundred.
verses.26:28: The sons of Asher according to their families were: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.26:29: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.26:30: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
verses.26:31: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were numbered of them: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.26:32: The sons of Joseph according to their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.26:33: The sons of Manasseh were: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir fathered Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
verses.26:34: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
verses.26:35: of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
verses.26:36: of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.26:37: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but only daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.26:38: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.26:39: These are the sons of Ephraim according to their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
verses.26:40: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.26:41: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were numbered of them: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph according to their families.
verses.26:42: The sons of Benjamin according to their families were: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
verses.26:43: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.26:44: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.26:45: These are the sons of Benjamin according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
verses.26:46: These are the sons of Dan according to their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan according to their families.
verses.26:47: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.26:48: The sons of Naphtali according to their families were: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
verses.26:49: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.26:50: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.26:51: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.26:52: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.26:53: "To these the land shall be divided as an inheritance, according to the number of names.
verses.26:54: To the more numerous you shall increase its inheritance, and to the fewer you shall diminish its inheritance; to each, according to those numbered of it, shall its inheritance be given.
verses.26:55: Nevertheless, the land shall be divided by lot; according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.26:56: According to the decision of the lot its inheritance shall be divided between the more numerous and the fewer."
verses.26:57: And these are those who were numbered of the Levites according to their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.26:58: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. And Kohath fathered Amram.
verses.26:59: Now the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and to Amram she bore Aaron and Moses, and their sister Miriam.
verses.26:60: And to Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.26:61: But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
verses.26:62: Now those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because no inheritance was given to them among the children of Israel.
verses.26:63: These are those who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.26:64: Yet among these there was not a man of those who had been numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they numbered the children of Israel in the Wilderness of Sinai.
verses.26:65: For the LORD had said of them, "They shall surely die in the wilderness." And not a man was left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.27:1: Then the daughters of Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, belonging to the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph, drew near; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.27:2: And they stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the leaders and all the congregation, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, saying,
verses.27:3: "Our father died in the wilderness, yet he was not among the company of those who assembled themselves against the LORD in the company of Korah; rather, he died in his own sin, and he had no sons.
verses.27:4: Why should the name of our father be withdrawn from the midst of his family because he has no son? Give us a possession among the brethren of our father."
verses.27:5: So Moses brought their case before the LORD.
verses.27:6: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.27:7: "The daughters of Zelophehad speak what is right; you shall surely give them a possession as an inheritance among their father's brothers, and you shall cause their father's inheritance to pass to them.
verses.27:8: And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'If a man dies and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
verses.27:9: And if he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.27:10: And if he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.
verses.27:11: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his nearest kinsman from his family, and he shall possess it.'" And this shall be a statute of judgment for the children of Israel, just as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.27:12: Now the LORD said to Moses, "Go up into this Mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
verses.27:13: And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, just as Aaron your brother was gathered.
verses.27:14: For in the Wilderness of Zin, during the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against My command to hallow Me at the waters before their eyes." These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin.
verses.27:15: Then Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,
verses.27:16: "Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
verses.27:17: who may go out before them and come in before them, who may lead them out and bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be like sheep which have no shepherd."
verses.27:18: And the LORD said to Moses, "Take Joshua the son of Nun with you, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand upon him;
verses.27:19: and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation, and charge him before their eyes.
verses.27:20: And you shall confer some of your majesty upon him, so that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
verses.27:21: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him—all the congregation."
verses.27:22: So Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
verses.27:23: And he laid his hands upon him and gave him his charge, just as the LORD had spoken by the hand of Moses.
verses.28:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.28:2: "Command the children of Israel, and say to them, 'You shall take care to present to Me at its appointed time My offering, My food for My offerings made by fire, as a sweet aroma to Me.'
verses.28:3: And you shall say to them, 'This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs a year old, without blemish, day by day, as a continual burnt offering.
verses.28:4: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer at twilight,
verses.28:5: along with one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with one-fourth of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.28:6: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.28:7: And its drink offering shall be one-fourth of a hin for the one lamb; in the holy place you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD.
verses.28:8: And the second lamb you shall offer at twilight; like the grain offering of the morning and like its drink offering you shall offer it, as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.
verses.28:9: And on the Sabbath day: two male lambs a year old, without blemish, and two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, along with its drink offering.
verses.28:10: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.28:11: At the beginnings of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, without blemish;
verses.28:12: three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
verses.28:13: and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.28:14: And their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering of each month throughout the months of the year.
verses.28:15: Also one male goat as a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.28:16: And on the fourteenth day of the first month is the Passover of the LORD.
verses.28:17: And on the fifteenth day of this month is a feast; for seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.28:18: On the first day there shall be a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.28:19: And you shall present an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish for you.
verses.28:20: And their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for a bull, and two-tenths of an ephah for a ram you shall offer;
verses.28:21: one-tenth of an ephah you shall offer for each lamb, for all seven lambs;
verses.28:22: also one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
verses.28:23: In addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for the continual burnt offering, you shall offer these.
verses.28:24: In this manner you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire as a sweet aroma to the LORD; it shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.28:25: And on the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.28:26: Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you present a new grain offering to the LORD at your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.28:27: You shall present a burnt offering as a sweet aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old,
verses.28:28: with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each bull, two-tenths of an ephah for the one ram,
verses.28:29: and one-tenth of an ephah for each lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.28:30: also one male goat, to make atonement for you.
verses.28:31: You shall offer them in addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering—they shall be without blemish for you—along with their drink offerings.'"
verses.29:1: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work. It shall be a day of trumpet blasts for you.
verses.29:2: And you shall prepare a burnt offering for a pleasing aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, without blemish.
verses.29:3: And their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths for the ram,
verses.29:4: and one-tenth for each lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.29:5: also one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
verses.29:6: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon and its grain offering, and the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings according to their ordinance, for a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.29:7: And on the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation, and you shall afflict your souls; you shall not do any work.
verses.29:8: And you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma: one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish for you.
verses.29:9: And their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
verses.29:10: one-tenth for each lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.29:11: one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:12: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work, and you shall celebrate a feast to the LORD for seven days.
verses.29:13: And you shall present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish.
verses.29:14: And their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each bull of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths for each ram of the two rams,
verses.29:15: and one-tenth for each lamb of the fourteen lambs;
verses.29:16: also one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.29:17: And on the second day: twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, without blemish;
verses.29:18: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:19: also one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:20: And on the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, without blemish;
verses.29:21: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:22: also one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.29:23: And on the fourth day: ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, without blemish;
verses.29:24: their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:25: also one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.29:26: And on the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, without blemish;
verses.29:27: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:28: also one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.29:29: And on the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, without blemish;
verses.29:30: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:31: also one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offerings.
verses.29:32: And on the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, without blemish;
verses.29:33: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to their ordinance;
verses.29:34: also one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.29:35: On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.29:36: And you shall present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, without blemish;
verses.29:37: their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:38: also one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.29:39: These you shall offer to the LORD at your appointed feasts, besides your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings and your grain offerings, for your drink offerings and your peace offerings.
verses.30:1: So Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.30:2: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, "This is the word which the LORD has commanded:
verses.30:3: If a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind himself by a pledge, he shall not profane his word; he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
verses.30:4: And if a woman vows a vow to the LORD, and binds herself by a pledge in her father's house in her youth,
verses.30:5: and her father hears her vow and her pledge by which she has bound herself, and her father keeps silent toward her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge by which she has bound herself shall stand.
verses.30:6: But if her father forbids her on the day he hears of it, none of her vows or her pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand; and the LORD will forgive her, because her father forbade her.
verses.30:7: And if she indeed marries a husband while her vows are upon her, or a rash utterance of her lips by which she has bound herself,
verses.30:8: and her husband hears of it, and on the day he hears it keeps silent toward her, then her vows shall stand, and her pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.
verses.30:9: But if on the day her husband hears of it he forbids her, then he shall annul her vow which is upon her and the rash utterance of her lips by which she has bound herself; and the LORD will forgive her.
verses.30:10: But as for the vow of a widow or of a divorced woman, everything by which she has bound herself shall stand against her.
verses.30:11: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound herself by a pledge with an oath,
verses.30:12: and her husband heard of it, and kept silent toward her, and did not forbid her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge by which she bound herself shall stand.
verses.30:13: But if her husband utterly annuls them on the day he hears of them, nothing that proceeded from her lips concerning her vows or concerning the pledge upon her soul shall stand; her husband has annulled them, and the LORD will forgive her.
verses.30:14: Every vow and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may confirm it, or her husband may annul it.
verses.30:15: Yet if her husband remains altogether silent toward her from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or all her pledges which are upon her; he has confirmed them, because he kept silent toward her on the day he heard of them.
verses.30:16: But if he indeed annuls them after he has heard of them, then he shall bear her iniquity."
verses.30:17: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter in her youth in her father's house.
verses.31:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:2: "Take vengeance for the children of Israel on the Midianites; afterward you shall be gathered to your people."
verses.31:3: Then Moses spoke to the people, saying, "Arm men from among you for war, and let them go against Midian to execute the vengeance of the LORD on Midian.
verses.31:4: A thousand from each tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to war."
verses.31:5: So there were supplied from the thousands of Israel a thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.31:6: And Moses sent them, a thousand from each tribe, to the war—them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest to the war, with the holy vessels and the trumpets for sounding the alarm in his hand.
verses.31:7: And they warred against Midian, just as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they slew every male.
verses.31:8: They slew the kings of Midian along with the rest of their slain—Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian; and Balaam the son of Beor they also slew with the sword.
verses.31:9: And the children of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones, and plundered all their cattle, all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.31:10: And all their cities in their dwelling places, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
verses.31:11: And they took all the spoil and all the plunder, both of man and of beast.
verses.31:12: Then they brought the captives, the plunder, and the spoil to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, at the camp in the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.31:13: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.
verses.31:14: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds—who had come from the service of the war.
verses.31:15: And Moses said to them, "Have you kept all the women alive?
verses.31:16: Behold, it was these who, through the counsel of Balaam, caused the children of Israel to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, so that the plague came upon the congregation of the LORD.
verses.31:17: Now therefore, slay every male among the little ones, and slay every woman who has known a man through lying with a male.
verses.31:18: But all the young girls who have not known lying with a male, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.31:19: And as for you, encamp outside the camp seven days; whoever has slain a person, and whoever has touched anyone slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, both you and your captives.
verses.31:20: And every garment, every article of leather, everything made of goats' hair, and every wooden article you shall purify."
verses.31:21: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had gone to the battle, "This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses:
verses.31:22: Only the gold, the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.31:23: everything that can withstand the fire, you shall pass through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless, it shall also be purified with the water of purification. And all that cannot withstand the fire you shall pass through water.
verses.31:24: And you shall wash your garments on the seventh day and be clean, and afterward you may come into the camp."
verses.31:25: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:26: "Take a count of the plunder that was captured, both of man and of beast—you, Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the congregation;
verses.31:27: and divide the plunder into two halves, between those who waged the war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
verses.31:28: And levy a tribute for the LORD from the men of war who went out to battle: one soul out of five hundred, of the people, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the sheep.
verses.31:29: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest as a heave offering to the LORD.
verses.31:30: And from the half belonging to the children of Israel you shall take one drawn out of every fifty—of the people, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the sheep, of all the livestock—and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD."
verses.31:31: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.31:32: Now the plunder, the remainder of the booty which the men of the army had seized, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
verses.31:35: and human persons, of the women who had not known lying with a male, thirty-two thousand persons in all.
verses.31:36: And the half, the portion for those who had gone out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;
verses.31:37: and the LORD's tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
verses.31:38: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD's tribute was seventy-two.
verses.31:39: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD's tribute was sixty-one.
verses.31:40: The human persons were sixteen thousand, of which the LORD's tribute was thirty-two persons.
verses.31:41: So Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD's heave offering, to Eleazar the priest, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.31:42: And as for the half belonging to the children of Israel, which Moses separated from the men who went to war:
verses.31:43: the congregation's half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
verses.31:47: From the half belonging to the children of Israel, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them to the Levites who kept charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.31:48: Then the officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses;
verses.31:49: and they said to Moses, "Your servants have taken a count of the men of war who are under our command, and not a man of us is missing.
verses.31:50: Therefore we have brought the LORD's offering, what every man found of articles of gold—armlets and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces—to make atonement for our souls before the LORD."
verses.31:51: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from them, all wrought articles.
verses.31:52: And all the gold of the heave offering that they presented to the LORD was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels, from the captains of thousands and from the captains of hundreds.
verses.31:53: The men of the army had taken plunder, every man for himself.
verses.31:54: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting as a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
verses.32:1: Now the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad possessed much livestock, an exceedingly great multitude; and they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and behold, the place was a place for livestock.
verses.32:2: So the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,
verses.32:3: "Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
verses.32:4: the land which the LORD struck down before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock."
verses.32:5: And they said, "If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession; do not bring us across the Jordan."
verses.32:6: Then Moses said to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, "Shall your brethren go into battle while you remain here?
verses.32:7: And why do you discourage the heart of the sons of Israel from crossing over into the land which the LORD has given them?
verses.32:8: Thus your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
verses.32:9: And they went up as far as the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, and they discouraged the heart of the sons of Israel so that they would not enter the land which the LORD had given them.
verses.32:10: Then the anger of the LORD was kindled on that day, and He swore, saying,
verses.32:11: 'Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, because they have not wholly followed Me,
verses.32:12: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, for they have wholly followed the LORD.'
verses.32:13: And the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation that did evil in the sight of the LORD was consumed.
verses.32:14: And behold, you have risen up in the place of your fathers, a brood of sinful men, to add yet more to the fierce wrath of the LORD against Israel.
verses.32:15: For if you turn away from following Him, He will yet again leave them in the wilderness, and you will destroy all this people."
verses.32:16: Then they drew near to him and said, "We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones,
verses.32:17: but we ourselves will arm ourselves swiftly before the sons of Israel, until we have brought them to their place; and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.32:18: We will not return to our houses until every one of the sons of Israel has taken possession of his inheritance.
verses.32:19: For we will not inherit with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan toward the east."
verses.32:20: And Moses said to them, "If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for war,
verses.32:21: and every armed man among you crosses over the Jordan before the LORD until He has driven out His enemies from before Him,
verses.32:22: and the land is subdued before the LORD, then afterward you may return and be guiltless before the LORD and before Israel; and this land shall be yours for a possession before the LORD.
verses.32:23: But if you do not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and know that your sin will find you out.
verses.32:24: Build for yourselves cities for your little ones and folds for your sheep, and do what has gone forth from your mouth."
verses.32:25: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, "Your servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.32:26: Our little ones, our wives, our livestock, and all our cattle shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
verses.32:27: but your servants will cross over, every man armed for warfare, before the LORD to battle, as my lord speaks."
verses.32:28: So Moses gave command concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel.
verses.32:29: And Moses said to them, "If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben cross over the Jordan with you, every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession.
verses.32:30: But if they do not cross over armed with you, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan."
verses.32:31: Then the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben answered, saying, "What the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
verses.32:32: We ourselves will cross over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us on this side of the Jordan."
verses.32:33: So Moses gave to them—to the sons of Gad, to the sons of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph—the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land with its cities within its borders, the cities of the land round about.
verses.32:34: And the sons of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, and Aroer;
verses.32:36: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran, fortified cities, and sheepfolds.
verses.32:37: And the sons of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, and Kiriathaim;
verses.32:38: and Nebo and Baal Meon—their names being changed—and Sibmah; and they gave other names to the cities which they built.
verses.32:39: And the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and captured it, and drove out the Amorites who were in it.
verses.32:40: So Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh, and he dwelt in it.
verses.32:41: Also Jair the son of Manasseh went and captured their villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
